package.name: amigo_bringup
package.description:
Hardware bringup for the AmigoBot: launches RosAria against the robot's serial-to-Ethernet bridge and remaps its topics onto the same names the simulation uses.
rosaria is deliberately an exec_depend only. This package contains no compiled code, so a workspace WITHOUT rosaria (and therefore without ARIA) still builds cleanly and the entire simulation half of the lab works.
